The Facility wastewater treatment process will be composed of headworks screening and grit removal facilities, a membrane bioreactor with submerged hollow-fiber membranes, solids dewatering screw press, and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection.

Waste activated sludge solids will be wasted from the membrane tanks to a dewatering screw press for dewatering of solids prior to being hauled off-site for further processing and reuse as compost, and/or disposal.
